Hi I just want to say from the bottom of my heart a big thank you for helping me get through the saddest time of losing my Shih Tzu Casper the staff and Vets all Vets are very good. They were the best in the world. They had a beautiful room set out for the last few hours with my Casper and I can’t thank them enough. Highly recommend Village Vets and Swords, they are the best. very professional. Thank you again for all the support you gave me.
Geraldine
Brought my large german shepherd ,the staff were great with him and the vet herself gave him a great check over.he got his medication and hopefully he is back to normal soon

We brought our dog to the emergency clinic last night with a very bad cough and fluid on his lungs, he is an old man and is in heart failure, Clodagh was the vet that was on and she was amazing with Alfie, I felt very reassured leaving him in her care, the nurse that took Alfie from me when we first went in was also amasing, Alfie is back home with us and has perked up with the treatment he recieved last night, I am very grateful to Clodagh and the Village vets team as his quality of life is extermely important to us.
Gorgeous group of people who work at lissenhall village vets great with my furbabies,have been going there for years and would highly recommend it 😀 ❤️ …

Always fantastic care for my dog when we visit Village Vets Lissenhall. From reception staff to nurses and of course vets themselves we always feel listened to and know that our dog receives the most thorough care on each and every occasion
Amazing staff really helped and explained everything
Excellent, kindest animal services
Perfect visit lovely and quite vet is a very nice lady and clearly loves animals!
Really helpful, friendly staff who go above and beyond for your pets care, pleasure to deal with and good piece of mind

My daughter changed vets about 2 months ago & the first time she took benson she said a fella named Jamie saw him & said he was a lovely guy. I took benson there again about a week ago & he has such a fear of the vets he does be shaking. So I was waiting in the waiting room & I could here a girl in the hall saying to some dog sit down stop it ur so bold. She had long brown hair & I did here from a few people she’s not a nice girl. I’m sorry if that’s the way she treats dogs when she knows he’s so afraid of the vets she shouldn’t be working there & I don’t want her to ever take benson again when he needs to go.
As always, Soria took great care of our cat and was in no rush at all. Great new look to the practice also after recent makeover. Highly recommend.

Hello Robin, thank you so much for your heartfelt words. We’re deeply sorry for the loss of your beloved cat. It was truly our honor to care for them, and we’re touched that our small gesture brought some comfort during such a difficult time. Your kind recommendation means a lot to all of us. Please know we’re thinking of you.

Excellent service , you can see they really want to help your pet and show a very caring professional attitude towards them. Would recommend this practice
Thank you for helping our little dog and the continued help

We had our first visit of the year to Village Vets (Lissenhall) on Friday as my CKC was a bit under the weather.  Its truly amazing how he perks up wen he goes there - clearly he's an attention seeker as he was just delighted to be fussed over by the veterinary nurses and his amazing vet Soraya.  I'm so glad he is a patient there!
